group: 前置部署与企业级 AI

questions.question: 实现一组计算面积的形状类，然后扩展它们以支持一种新的形状。
questions.questionEn: Implement a set of shape classes that compute area, then extend them to handle a new shape.

questions.question: 写一条 SQL 查询，跨表 join 并聚合，以回答某个业务问题。
questions.questionEn: Write a SQL query that joins and aggregates across tables to answer a business question.

questions.question: 构建一个函数，从 REST API 分页拉取数据，并处理 page size 与总页数逻辑。
questions.questionEn: Build a function that fetches paginated data from a REST API, handling page size and total-page logic.

questions.question: 在一个用 HashMap 统计数值的函数中，找出并修复重复计数的 bug。
questions.questionEn: Find and fix a double-counting bug in a function that tallies values in a HashMap.

questions.question: 调试一个在社交图谱上模拟感染传播的程序。
questions.questionEn: Debug a program that models infection spread across a social graph.

questions.question: 你从上一个部署项目接手了一个 800 行的 pipeline 脚本。它很慢，而且偶尔会算出错误的数字。原作者已经离职。开始吧。
questions.questionEn: You inherit an 800-line pipeline script from a previous deployment. It's slow and occasionally produces wrong numbers. The original author is gone. Go.

questions.question: 给定来自三个客户系统的导出数据，每个系统都有自己的客户记录，请编写代码产出去重后的统一实体集合，并说明你的设计。
questions.questionEn: Given exports from three customer systems, each with its own customer records, write code to produce one deduplicated set of entities and explain your design.

questions.question: 用户问“有多少未完成订单因供应商问题被卡住？”朴素 RAG 会答错。为什么，正确的架构是什么？
questions.questionEn: Users ask “how many open orders are blocked on a supplier issue?” Plain RAG gets this wrong. Why, and what's the right architecture?

questions.question: 在 Palantir 的语境里，ontology 是什么？为什么要把 LLM agent 放在 ontology 之上，而不是直接放在原始表和文档之上？
questions.questionEn: What is an ontology in the Palantir sense, and why put LLM agents on top of one instead of on raw tables and documents?

questions.question: 设计一个 LLM agent，在客户的 ERP 中提交和更新工单：这是对生产系统的真实写入。你如何保证其安全性？
questions.questionEn: Design an LLM agent that files and updates work orders in a customer's ERP: real writes to a production system. How do you make that safe?

questions.question: 你的平台必须支持多家 LLM 供应商，包括在受限环境中只提供部分模型的部署。你如何设计模型选择的架构？
questions.questionEn: Your platform must support multiple LLM providers, including deployments in restricted environments where only some models are available. How do you architect model selection?

questions.question: 在让 LLM 工作流接入生产运维之前和之后，你分别如何评估它？
questions.questionEn: How do you evaluate an LLM workflow before and after giving it access to production operations?

questions.question: 一家货运铁路运营商每年因机车非计划停机损失数千万。请把它拆解成一份工程计划。
questions.questionEn: A freight rail operator loses tens of millions a year to unplanned locomotive downtime. Decompose this into an engineering plan.

questions.question: 设计一个改善 NYC 交通的系统。
questions.questionEn: Design a system to improve traffic in NYC.

questions.question: 设计两个员工记录系统之间的同步系统。
questions.questionEn: Design a sync system between two employee record systems.

questions.question: 设计一个让多个团队都能查询共享数据集、又不暴露原始数据的系统。
questions.questionEn: Design a system that lets multiple teams query a shared dataset without exposing raw data.

questions.question: 设计一个在探索陌生环境时对物种进行编目和记录的应用。
questions.questionEn: Design an application to catalog and log species while exploring an unfamiliar environment.

questions.question: 一位客户高管说“这个 AI 老是出错”，并想取消试点。请说明你接下来 48 小时会怎么做。
questions.questionEn: A customer executive says “the AI keeps getting things wrong” and wants to cancel the pilot. Walk me through your next 48 hours.

questions.question: 为什么选择 Palantir，为什么是这个团队？讲一次你对客户需求提出异议的经历。
questions.questionEn: Why Palantir, and why this team? Tell me about a time you pushed back on a customer request.

questions.question: Palantir 与国防和情报机构合作。你如何看待这一点？如果被要求构建让你感到不适的东西，你会怎么做？
questions.questionEn: Palantir works with defence and intelligence agencies. How do you think about that, and what would you do if asked to build something you're uncomfortable with?
